# Mathematical Publishing Proof of Concept

**Status: typography and workflow demonstration only. No physical system is modeled or validated.**

Consider an abstract algebraic identity:

$$
(a-b)^2=a^2+b^2-2ab.
$$ {#eq-algebra-demo}

A multi-line derivation tests aligned mathematics:

$$
\begin{aligned}
(a-b)^2
 &= (a-b)(a-b) \\
 &= a^2-ab-ba+b^2 \\
 &= a^2+b^2-2ab.
\end{aligned}
$$

Equation @eq-algebra-demo is a deliberately trivial mathematical test; it does not establish any receiver performance. A source citation will be added only once an actual relevant source has been examined and recorded.

| Symbol | Meaning | Units |
|:--|:--|:--|
| $a$ | Arbitrary real variable | Dimensionless |
| $b$ | Arbitrary real variable | Dimensionless |

: Table layout demonstration. {#tbl-layout-demo}
